adjudicated_by: architect (enterprise-architect subagent, Claude Fable 5.1): Gate 7 separation for a terminal disposition over a gating row: not the change author, not the reporter (plugin-developer), not the main session arguing it. The operator approved this disposition in session. The adjudicator is a subagent of the authoring session, so its independence is asserted, not verified.
adjudication_rationale: Band NOT restated down: derived HIGH (I1,I2; E3,E5). Provenance pre-existing: the diff neither creates the wrong outcome nor connects it to a trigger that could not reach it before. AgentImpl::stop() latches subprocess cancel (agent.cpp ~3767) before guardian_->stop() (~3801); run_bounded_subprocess kills a cancelled child at its first poll with zero grace and quarantine run_tool sets none, so the fallback netsh in win_unquarantine is killed, the action reports release_uncertain (rc 1) and the prior-policy record is retained (quarantine_plugin.cpp ~706-721, 2186-2189): same terminal outcome at a 5 s or 1 s budget. The wrong outcome (a failed storage read read as no record) is reachable today on dev outside shutdown and is the get twin of open #5037. Measured on weecolin (real subprocess_runner.cpp at c937d639c, proxy command netsh advfirewall set currentprofile logging maxfilesize, unloaded, one machine): 0 of 100 writes landed under a pre-latched cancel; pre-latched kill median 15.9 ms against netsh own write at about 47 ms (writes land from about 32 ms); about 2x margin. Residuals not created by this PR: r1 netsh finishing inside spawn-to-kill latency (measured unloaded only, not under CPU load); r2 run() scope-exit calls guardian_->stop() (~1115) before latching cancel (~1143), reachability with a command in flight not verified. No honest in-PR mitigation: a per-caller budget lets a 5 s plugin wait hold KvStore::mu_ and re-open the stop overrun; lowering after plugins finish defeats the PR; the root fix needs #5037 tri-state exists plus a quarantine consumer change, a plugin-ABI contract and its own review unit. First application of deferred-to-issue over a derived-HIGH row (lower-band precedent #5037); the skill is silent on this reading of Gate 7 never-deferred. The reviewer cited DND storage_set lines ~1458/1487 that do not exist at HEAD: that sub-claim is dropped.
